correctness.rationale: The exact palindrome-digit-prefix identity A_b(n)=H+floor(n/H)+epsilon-2, with H=b^{ceil(floor(log_b n)/2)}, gives a uniform O(n^{-1/2}) error after dividing by sqrt(n). Writing Delta=distance(log_b n,2Z) yields phase profile 2 cosh((log b)Delta/2). For rationally independent reciprocals 1/log b_i, the weighted character sums sum_{n<=X} n^{-1+i*pi*sum h_i/log b_i}=O_h(1) for each nonzero integer h via integral comparison; Weyl gives logarithmically weighted Haar equidistribution on k-torus. Uniform phase distances produce independent Uniform[0,1], so ordering events are continuity sets, ties density zero. The ordered-volume formula and for b<c with irrational log ratio d{A_b>A_c}=log b/(2 log c) follow. Explicit b_j=3*2^j are jointly Q-independent: alpha=log2/log3 is transcendental by irrationality + Gelfond–Schneider, and a rational relation among 1/(1+j alpha) forces a zero polynomial whose partial-fraction residues vanish. Independently verified 13,194 (n,base) exact palindrome counts for bases 2,3,4,5,8,10 and n1..2199; checked source checker and arithmetic argument. These finite tests do not prove equidistribution.

originality.rationale: Phunphayap–Pongsriiam 2022 and 2023 full primary PDFs establish extremal comparisons, sign changes, recurrent equalities, and explicitly ask for arbitrary strict k-base orderings under weaker conditions. Their inspected sections do not provide a product logarithmic limiting law, exact ordering chamber volumes or the explicit arbitrarily-long independent family. The result does not claim to solve their full pairwise-log-irrationality conjecture, since rational independence is stronger. Standard equidistribution and Gelfond–Schneider are plainly attributed. A broader independent published race law could imply this theorem; retained as risk.
